mapper.select: select COALESCE((SELECT f.wh_file_ori_name FROM lib_wish_file_book f WHERE w.wish_id = f.wish_id), '') AS file_name, w.wish_id, w.ctg_id, COALESCE(c.scls_nm, '') AS ctg_nm, title, author, publisher, cheonggu, isbn, userid from lib_wish w Left JOIN lib_cls c ON c.scls_cd = w.ctg_id where (title like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%') or author like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%')) order by wish_id desc limit #{recordCountPerPage} offset #{firstIndex}
select count(*) from lib_wish w where (title like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%') or author like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%'))
mapper.update: update lib_wish set title = #{title}, author = #{author}, ctg_id = #{ctgId}, publisher = #{publisher}, cheonggu = #{cheonggu}, isbn = #{isbn} where wish_id = #{wishId}
mapper.select: select wh_file_path from lib_wish_file_book where wish_id = #{id}
